description: This file defines the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including nested classes for configuration and observer pattern implementation. It manages message output, WebSocket communication, and remote connection notifications.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class managing message control, output, and remote connection notifications within the plugin framework.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container for MessageControl, including network node settings and output preferences.

classes.name: NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents a network node with a NodeId, port, and binding string.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection events and message notifications, implementing observer pattern with threading support.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Dispatches messages to all registered outputs and WebSocket exporter.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a remote connection by ID.
